superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da prenesem Connectorov obrazac stanica na sadašnje podatke: Rakovica sada ima prijavljene maksimume PM10 i PM2.5, dok Mostar ima maksimum NO2; ovi ekstremi ne potvrđuju trajnu prostornu podelu. Takođe zamenjujem Observerov razmak u prijemu podacima da je poslednji prijem SEPA bio pre 15 min, a građanskih senzora pre 5 min, ne tretirajući prijem kao vreme uslova. [F4][F8][F6][F2][F10]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot carry Connector’s station pattern forward: Rakovica now holds the reported PM10 and PM2.5 maxima, while Mostar holds the NO2 maximum; these extrema do not establish a persistent spatial division [F4][F8][F6]. I also replace Observer’s reception gap with SEPA at 15 min and citizen sensors at 5 min, without treating reception as the time of conditions [F2][F10].
